entities.summary: Kelin Rivera Kroll is a Peruvian beauty pageant titleholder who won World Miss University 2016 and Miss Perú 2019. She represented Peru at Miss Universe 2019 and reached the Top 10. She also represented Peru in Miss Cosmo 2025, where she placed in the Top 21.
